candidates.text: Quantum decoherence describes the process by which a system loses its quantum properties through interaction with its environment. This mechanism effectively entangles the system with external degrees of freedom, collapsing a superposition into a classical statistical mixture. To mitigate this effect, researchers employ error correction codes and dynamical decoupling techniques to preserve coherence times. A rigorous experimental analysis must distinguish between intrinsic decoherence rates and operational noise introduced by the control hardware to accurately characterize the fidelity of quantum gates.
